Open specimens.afa and hypotheses.spart. Try Manual/Combine and deduplication; all eight IDs must map back, including duplicates. time-binary.nwk is a normal GMYC time tree; time.nwk tests ties/polytomies. substitutions.nwk is a PTP input with stipulated substitutions/site, unsuitable for GMYC. Branch units are supplied here, not encoded by Newick. Small data can yield uninformative estimates; construction groups are not validated species.
